newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand revises 1997 rice export target up.
newsitem.headline: Thailand revises 1997 rice export target up.

text.p: Thailand's commerce ministry said on Friday revised its 1997 rice exports target up to 5.35 million tonnes from an earlier projection of 5.0 million tonnes made in December.
The rice exports were expected to fetch 47.05 billion baht ($180.9 million) in foreign exchange this year, a ministry statement said.
In 1996, Thailand exported 5.3 million tonnes of rice worth 48.23 million baht.
"Thailand will take about 30 percent of the world market share on rice (in 1997)," the ministry said.
It expected high quality rice to maintain its competitive edge while the prices of lower quality rice would likely come under pressure from cheaper products from Vietnam and India.
"Thailand major markets for this year will continue to be China, Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Iran, Hong Kong, the United States, the Philippines and Nigeria," the statement said.
